pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: NHAI / road infrastructure financing

patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: definitions (zero-base budgeting, revenue deficit formula), non-plan = interest payments, who presented a budget.
Receipt classification (revenue vs capital, tax vs non-tax, disinvestment/borrowings) recurs across PSCs; classic trap is small savings/disinvestment as revenue.
Cut motions (policy Re 1, token Rs 100), guillotine and vote on account are frequent match/one-liner items.
Current budget figures are asked as simple recall (who presented, FD % RE vs BE), plus AP-angle items like Vision 2030 in Interim Budget 2019.
App MCQs are heavier on multi-statement and 2026-27 figure detail than the PYQs; many 2026-27 items go deeper than APPSC's typical depth.
